title: Improved Stonecutters
description: change deepslate into cobbled deepslate, and packed mud into mud bricks!
body:
# Improved Stonecutters

This very simple datpack allows the user to change deepslate into cobbled deepslate, and mud into mud bricks. Features the base game should have, but doesnt for some weird reason!

# Crafting

Simply put your Deepslate or your Packed Mud in a stonecutter. That's it! It's ver simple, yet effective!

![Deepslate to Cobbled Deepslate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dbb4968da4b9bcbd968fa2a2be34f9be0e30691.png)

![Mud to Mud Bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9c71cde6907dc7006127c602d2dae2e15999403.png)

**Big 'Thanks' to Enki1 for helping with this idea!**

# AutoCraft (ad)
This datapack was developed for the AutoCraft Server, and has been in use since!
